mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1.1 million units signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced durable goods demand, which triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1100.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a contraction in manufacturing output and labor market stress, indicating an imminent economic slowdown that depresses equity valuations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 100.0 and UNRATE > 4.5 (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% per year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers expectations of future rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS <= 1.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 4% year-over-year, combined with rising housing starts, signals strong aggregate demand that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS > 4.0 and HOUST > 1200.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% combined with a sustained increase in non-farm payrolls above 200k signals a labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth below 1.5% annualized, combined with falling industrial production, signals a weakening economy that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 < 1.5 and INDPRO < 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
